item.title: NY AG James sues landlords over inhumane conditions: Freezing, rats, and sewage
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James has filed a lawsuit against the owners of an Orange County apartment complex for allegedly forcing tenants to endure freezing temperatures, sewage leaks, and rodent infestations, and for retaliating against tenants who spoke up.

item.title: Juvenile dead in Town of Russia snowmobile accident
item.description: New York State Police are investigating a snowmobile accident in the Town of Russia that has taken the life of a 16-year-old juvenile.

item.title: What is a 287(g) agreement?
item.description: Governor Kathy Hochul has proposed voiding New York's 14 current 287(g) agreements and prohibiting future agreements, which would expand on Executive Order 170 and codify the directive that local law enforcement is not legally required to honor civil detainer requests from ICE.

item.title: New York attorney general to deploy legal observers to monitor federal immigration agents
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — New York's attorney general announced plans Tuesday to deploy legal observers to monitor federal immigration enforcement actions in the state. item.title: Nassau County Executive Blakeman defies state plan to end ICE cooperation
item.description: Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman has vowed to fight a proposal to ban local police from acting as federal immigration agents, while Governor Kathy Hochul has introduced the "Local Cops, Local Crimes Act" to do just that.

item.title: Halonen added to AHL All-Star roster
item.description: Another Utica Comet will be heading off to the festivities of All-Star Weekend, according to a team announcement on Facebook.

item.description: One of the corrections officers acquitted in the Robert Brooks trial is now suing the state for several charges, including malicious prosecution.

item.title: Rome Police investigating Court Street vehicle-versus-pedestrian accident
item.description: Rome Police are asking for the public's help in an accident Tuesday morning, which left one person critically injured.
